name: @gofastr/imageedit-editor-bundle
description: In-frame image editor bundle for the GoFastr imageedit plugin. Builds a single dependency-free IIFE that runs inside the opaque-origin sandboxed iframe and speaks protocol v1 to the host over postMessage: the source bytes arrive as an ArrayBuffer over the bridge (connect-src 'none' — the frame never fetches), the editor previews the operation list with the same integer pipeline the Go server runs, and export sends ONLY the doc.
